title: Meet the Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, Curio Collection by Hilton Team Helping Guests Make Space to Slow Down
summary: In Japan’s forested hills, thoughtful team members create a peaceful retreat and invite guests to savor their own company.
body_markdown:

In Japan’s forested hills, thoughtful team members create a peaceful retreat where nature, meaningful connections and quiet moments of care invite guests to savor their own company


- **Go behind the scenes with the latest installment of Hilton's Behind the Stay series, spotlighting the remarkable team members whose passion and dedication make Hilton the World's Best Place to Stay.**
- **Discover how the Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, Curio Collection by Hilton team draws inspiration from Karuizawa's natural beauty to create a restorative retreat where guests can breathe deeply, slow their pace and simply enjoy the moment.**
- **Meet the people who bring thoughtful care to every part of the stay, from a warm welcome at the train station and peaceful guest rooms to locally-inspired cuisine and the small, everyday gestures that make guests slow down and unwind.**


Sometimes, the best way to reconnect with yourself is to get away from the noise. For travelers, finding a haven that gives them a chance to do just that has become increasingly important. In fact,[Hilton's 2027 Trends Report](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/2027-trends-release) found that 65% actively seek experiences that calm the body and reset the nervous system, while 76% say travel helps them recharge mentally and physically in ways they can't easily achieve at home. In the Japanese mountain resort town of Karuizawa, this shift is felt as soon as travelers step off the train. Here, the air feels cooler and cleaner as tree-lined streets replace the hurried pace of the city. Amid this nature-lover’s paradise is[Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/mmjkzqq-kyukaruizawa-kikyo/) , a remarkable hotel where a deep connection to Karuizawa’s natural surroundings and a dedicated team’s thoughtful care create a distinctive sense of place.


That sense of return shapes the experience that follows, as at Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, Curio Collection by Hilton a sense of renewal can be as simple as breathing deeply outdoors, waking to natural light or looking up at a sky filled with stars. General Manager Yoichi Sano believes those simple experiences can help people reconnect with themselves. "Some people might just call that country living," he says, but for him, those everyday encounters with nature help guests fully rest and recharge.


And there is plenty of nature to encounter here. Marketing & Communications team member Midori Onoyama describes Karuizawa as beautiful in every season, and the team encourages guests to experience that beauty at their own pace. Reflecting Curio Collection by Hilton’s commitment to thoughtfully curated experiences that celebrate the unique spirit of each destination, the hotel invites guests to connect with Karuizawa’s natural surroundings in meaningful ways. Here, slowing down is part of the experience, and that same feeling follows guests back to their rooms, where Housekeeping Team Lead Mika Aruga wants the sense of clarity guests experience outdoors in Karuizawa to continue inside the hotel. Her team creates calm, uncluttered spaces designed to evoke the same crisp freshness as the mountain air.


Head of Kitchen Ken Shirai is equally committed to this sense of wellbeing, forming relationships with local growers that have given him a new appreciation for each ingredient and the care that goes into growing it. And it’s this dedication to every aspect of the experience that makes Kyukaruizawa Kikyo a place where guests can truly feel at home.


Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, Curio Collection by Hilton - Exterior


Hitoshi says it all comes down to the Japanese phrase bonji tettei, which he describes as doing the small things thoroughly, day in and day out. And at Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, this philosophy is woven into the property’s own bespoke story, brought to life through the people, thoughtful gestures, and meaningful connections that shape each guest’s stay. From a seamless welcome at the station to a peaceful room waiting at the end of the day, these small moments reflect the team’s commitment to making ever stay distinctive. Together, they create a space where guests can slow down, feel cared for and find their way back to themselves.


##### FAQ: Meet the Kyukaruizawa Kikyo Team Helping Guests Make Space to Slow Down


Nestled in the forested hills of Karuizawa, Japan, Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, Curio Collection by Hilton, offers a tranquil escape where guests can reconnect with nature and themselves. From peaceful guest rooms and locally inspired cuisine to thoughtfully curated experiences that celebrate the destination's natural beauty, the hotel creates an inviting environment for travelers seeking rest, relaxation and renewal.


At Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, thoughtful Japanese hospitality is reflected in the philosophy of bonji tettei, which emphasizes doing the small things thoroughly and consistently. From seamless arrivals at the train station to calming guest rooms and cuisine featuring locally sourced ingredients, the hotel's dedicated team members embrace meaningful gestures that help guests feel genuinely welcomed and cared for.


Curio Collection by Hilton is a global collection of individually remarkable hotels, each with its own distinct story, character and connection to the surrounding destination. Through thoughtfully curated experiences, locally inspired offerings and personalized service, properties like Kyukaruizawa Kikyo invite travelers to discover the authentic culture, natural beauty and unique spirit of the places they visit.


Featured in Hilton's Behind the Stay series, the Kyukaruizawa Kikyo, Curio Collection by Hilton team demonstrates how thoughtful hospitality and genuine human connections can transform a hotel stay into a restorative experience. From helping guests discover Karuizawa's natural surroundings to creating peaceful spaces and memorable dining experiences, team members bring Hilton's vision of becoming the World's Best Place to Stay to life through personalized care and attention to the smallest details.
